title: Bank impersonation, safe account, coached through the questions
coverStory: Say you are moving savings between your own accounts. If they ask whether anyone told you to do this, say nobody.
payerBackground: A retired teacher who has banked with the same bank for forty years. A man calling himself from the fraud team told her, twenty-six minutes ago, that her account has been compromised by someone inside the bank and that her money must be moved tonight to a reserve account in her own name. He has been calm and patient and has already known her address and the last four digits of her card.
